control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.title: high potential incident during commissioning of replacement equipment on ZV-7211

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on ZV-7211 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on ZV-7211 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. ZV-7211 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 2 March 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on ZV-7211 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during commissioning of replacement equipment; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
